parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.85, topP: 0.95, topK: 40, maxOutputTokens: 4096, responseMimeType: "application/json" }, contents: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ text: "You are the head of content. Plan one full week for this brand. You are not writing the posts, you are deciding what gets made, where it goes, and why that order.

THE WEEK HAS AN ARC. Day one earns attention, the middle days build the case, the last days convert. Say what the arc is.

STRUCTURE RULES, a validator checks every one of these
- Cover all seven days. Every day_no from 1 to 7 must appear at least once.
- Between 9 and 12 slots in total. Some days carry ONE platform, some days carry TWO or THREE. Vary it deliberately, never the same shape every day.
- Every platform in the menu must appear at least once. No single platform may take more than 40 percent of the slots.
- When a day carries more than one platform, those slots must do DIFFERENT jobs, never the same post cross posted. Say in why_here how they differ.
- topic is a specific arguable claim in one sentence, never a category. Weak: automation tips. Strong: most founders automate the wrong process first because it is the one they hate.
- No two topics may make the same argument. Twelve slots means twelve genuinely different claims.
- Do NOT repeat or rephrase anything under ALREADY POSTED.
- angle_hint is one line telling the writer the entry point to take.
- pillar is one word from your own set of three to five pillars that you also return.
- NEVER invent a statistic, a date, a client name or a result.
- Never write an em dash or en dash.

FORMAT MENU, use the exact strings: " + $json.format_menu + "
PLATFORM MENU, use the exact strings: " + $json.platform_menu + "
Match format to platform sensibly. A carousel belongs on Instagram or LinkedIn. A broadcast belongs on WhatsApp. A short script belongs on YouTube Shorts.

Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: week_theme, arc, pillars (array of strings), slots (array of objects with day_no, platform, format, topic, angle_hint, pillar, why_here).

THE THEME FOR THIS WEEK:
" + $json.theme + "

THE DAYS:
" + $json.days_text + "

BRAND:
" + $json.brand_context + "

VOICE RULES the writers will follow:
" + $json.style_text + "

Never use these words: " + $json.banned_text + "

ALREADY POSTED, do not repeat any of these:
" + $json.already_used }] }] }) }}
